newsitem.title: USA: Tridex says unit gets Crown contract.
newsitem.headline: Tridex says unit gets Crown contract.

text.p: Tridex Corp said Monday its Ultimate Technology Corp subsidiary was chosen to design, manufacture and install a computer system used for sales at Crown Books Corp's retail stores.

Tridex said it believes the potential total value of the contract will be about $10 million. An initial equipment rollout valued at about $1.5 million is scheduled for delivery during the third quarter ending September 30.
The company said the system is scheduled to be installed in 60 of Crown Books' 169 stores this year as part. It said Crown also expects to open 40 new stores per year.
